name: RuneScape Dragonwilds
description: RuneScape: Dragonwilds is a co-operative survival crafting game set on RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall. This script installs the dedicated server (Steam app 4019830) via SteamCMD so you can host a persistent world for up to six players.

notes.text: The server is installed but not started. Set OWNER_ID in /opt/runescape-dragonwilds/dragonwilds.env, then run: systemctl start runescape-dragonwilds
Your Owner ID is your RuneScape: Dragonwilds player ID, shown at the bottom of the in-game settings menu. It is mandatory for the server to start.
A generated admin password is stored in /opt/runescape-dragonwilds/dragonwilds.env. Anyone who knows it can open the Server Management tab in the in-game pause menu.
The host CPU must support the AVX instruction set, otherwise the server binary will not run.
Allow 7777/UDP (game) and 27015/UDP (Steam query) through any firewall or router. Both are configurable in the env file.
Jagex caps dedicated servers at 6 players. Plan for 2GB RAM plus 1GB per player.
To find your server in-game, open the Public tab of the Worlds screen and search for the exact world name (case sensitive).
